tools.name: list_care_options
tools.description: Read Bidwell Health’s public catalogue, including paused services. No personal information is needed.

tools.name: check_service_availability
tools.description: Check whether a listed Bidwell service is offered in a state. This checks service scope, not personal medical eligibility. Inputs are limited to service and state; symptoms and identifying information are not accepted.

tools.name: get_service_details
tools.description: Read the current official service guide: who it serves, published medication options, preparation, pharmacy arrangements, limits, expected timelines and FAQs when published. General education only; no symptoms or personal details accepted. Returns sourced service details, not an individual treatment

tools.name: explain_visit
tools.description: Read the public visit fee, payment terms, clinician-review requirement and service limitations. Does not book a visit or recommend treatment.

tools.name: get_service_page
tools.description: Return the official informational page for an available service and state. No intake is submitted and no personal information is carried in the link.

tools.name: get_online_care_boundaries
tools.description: Read sourced general boundaries and emergency guidance for a service. No symptom questions or personal screening; this does not determine individual eligibility or safety. Excerpts are checked against the current website and fail closed if they change.

tools.name: get_bridge_refill_rules
tools.description: Read the published stable-dose, monitoring, supply, documentation and medication-exclusion rules. Medication names, prescriptions, photos and personal history are not accepted as inputs. This is not approval to refill a particular drug.

tools.name: get_location_guidance
tools.description: Explain the physical-location rule, including visitors and short stays. State is where care would take place, not home residence. No address, travel dates, itinerary or personal information accepted. A layover does not guarantee completion before departure.

tools.name: get_next_step
tools.description: Return a public guide, the Start Visit picker when available, a state waitlist for unsupported locations, or portal sign-in for existing patients. No direct intake or checkout links, no form filling, and no private portal access.

tools.name: get_practice_facts
tools.description: Return sourced practice facts and independently verifiable public clinician credentials. No ratings, endorsements or personalized clinical claims.

tools.name: get_assistant_policy
tools.description: Read the public connector limits and website handoff policy. Screening, attestations, payment and care decisions are patient and clinician responsibilities on the practice website.

tools.name: get_intimate_health_education
tools.description: Read a general, unranked comparison of BV, vaginal yeast and UTI, with linked prevention and recurrence research on probiotics, D-mannose and other options, plus an interactive learning guide. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_practice_facts" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Return sourced practice facts and independently verifiable public clinician credentials. No ratings, endorsements or personalized clinical claims.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: explain_visit · Private data: get_next_step, get_practice_facts · Public sink: get_intimate_health_education.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: explain_visit · Private data: get_next_step, get_practice_facts · Public sink: get_intimate_health_education

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
